destinations.cp1_table_1: Table 1. Resolution-aware inference settings implemented in the executed notebook.
destinations.cp1_figure_1: Figure 1. Executed-v2 dashboard for the detailed clip: predicted entering/exiting class counts, vehicle-type distribution, smoothed tracked vehicles per frame, and detection-confidence distribution (mean 0.568).
destinations.cp1_figure_2: Figure 2. Detection-confidence bands from 686 tracked detections: 120 low, 206 medium, 232 high, and 128 very high. This is not a ground-truth confusion matrix.
destinations.cp1_table_2: Table 2. Predicted directional tripwire crossings in the detailed executed-v2 clip.
destinations.cp1_figure_3: Figure 3. Predicted box-area distribution (left) and directional flow (right: one entering, three exiting) in the detailed clip.
destinations.cp1_table_3: Table 3. Predicted tripwire crossings in the selected 80 clips by camera. Soft counts are uncalibrated confidence-weighted sums.
destinations.cp1_table_4: Table 4. Next-segment held-out classification on the same 32 clips.
destinations.cp1_table_5: Table 5. Per-class YOLO11-feature XGBoost precision, recall and F1 on the 32-clip holdout.
destinations.cp1_table_6: Table 6. YOLO11-feature XGBoost confusion matrix; rows are true future labels, columns are predictions.
destinations.cp1_table_7: Table 7. Descriptive predicted crossings on the same 80 clips. Soft sums are uncalibrated confidence weights.
destinations.cp1_figure_4: Figure 4. Stage-A original matched next-segment classification confusion matrices on the same 32 clips. Rows are true future classes, columns predicted classes; both matrices have 12 correct predictions. These evaluate congestion classification, not vehicle detection.
destinations.cp1_table_8: Table 8. Sequential experiment protocols and selected-model outcomes. Stage-C test counts are free flowing / heavy delay / light delay / moderate delay; cross-stage accuracy differences are not controlled gains.
destinations.cp1_figure_5: Figure 5. Process followed from the original matched pilot to cached-feature re-evaluation and expanded YOLO11 evaluation. Stage C changes the sample and class proportions; arrows indicate workflow, not guaranteed improvement.
destinations.cp1_table_9: Table 9. Stage-B cached-feature evaluation and controls on the same original 32 test clips.
destinations.cp1_table_10: Table 10. Stage-C class composition and selected logistic-regression performance. The single moderate-delay example provides very limited evidence for that class.
destinations.cp1_table_11: Table 11. Stage-C expanded evaluation. Every method uses the same 64 clips; balanced accuracy is mean class recall.
destinations.cp1_table_A1: Table A1. Notation used in the proposed formulations.
